signatures.description: Without any third-party numeric library, implement merging of K LoRA adapters into a frozen base matrix per layer given W (row-major float32 hex), A_i (r_i by d_in), B_i (d_out by r_i) and scale a_i, forming dW = sum(B_i*A_i*(a_i/r_i)) in float64 and truncating it to rank r_max via a from-scratch SVD (Householder bidiagonalization plus implicit-shift QR, or two-sided Jacobi) before emitting W' = W + dW_trunc. For each layer output the r_max retained singular values in descending order, the discarded Frobenius mass, the relative error ||W'-(W+dW)||_F/||W+dW||_F, the smallest retained singular-value gap used for the truncation decision, and a sequential_equivalent flag that must be true exactly when K=1 or r_max >= sum(r_i) and then agree with sequential adapter application to 1e-12 relative. Reject any layer whose effective scale is non-finite or whose dW overflows float32 with a machine-readable diagnostic, and answer each query W'x from the truncated factors only when r_max*(d_in+d_out) < d_out*d_in, falling back to the materialized matrix otherwise; report which path was taken per query.
